name: Mautic
line: Self-hosted marketing automation with newsletters and API-triggered mail.

free.text: Free open-source software; provide hosting and email delivery

cells.newsletters: Yes, segmented broadcasts and marketing journeys
cells.api: Yes, HTTP API can send a stored email to a contact

subs.math: 1,000 contacts × 4 campaigns = 4,000 emails a month. $24 server (4GB) plus Amazon SES at $0.16 per 1,000, with production access. This is only the known part; data, backups and tax are extra.
